candidates.severity: unassigned; conditional backend admission under two absent settlement IDs and otherwise satisfied authority and relationship guards
candidates.classification: New bounded 95e aggregate/co-location assessment linked to an earlier Lens12 relationship contract question; not a runtime or exploit observation.
candidates.first_failed_contract: The canonical pair validator advertises co-location but rejects only unequal Option<settlement> values. Two None values compare equal, so two otherwise eligible adults outside settlements can pass that check even if at different case sites or journeys. ExclusiveShared temporal scope checks the actor clock, target existence and canonical time but adds no spatial validation. Normal case-site arrival sets current_settlement_id to None while storing separate site occupancy. If the other formal or informal route, affinity, kinship and authority checks succeed, the selected begin reducer can establish a courtship without establishing a shared location.
candidates.scope_and_safeguards: This is a conditional reducer contract, not an observed player incident. A sender must be the registered gateway or owner of the target disposable simulation character. The selected ordinary web NPC romance handler first checks the actor settlement and the NPC location/presence; the NPC-to-NPC scheduling path independently requires a present equal settlement. Other callers, deployment access, actual admitted affinity and geographic/temporal location policy remain unproven. The source does not prove that every equal Some settlement implies shared detailed location, nor that outside-settlement courtship should be supported.
candidates.related_observer_consequence: Informal establishment snapshots adult living family observers by comparing each current settlement Option to the pair settlement. If the pair location is None, another observer with None can be admitted to this fixed cohort without a demonstrated shared place, subject to all other guards. This is a connected consequence of absent-location equality, not an independently counted unique defect.
candidates.connected_repair: After the audit gate settle the intended spatial policy at the canonical mutation boundary. Require an explicit common authoritative place, or reject unsupported absent-settlement modes, and reconcile establishment-time observer eligibility with that same decision. Preserve gateway presence policy, NPC scheduling, chronology, existing affinity/rejection behavior and the deliberate fixed observer cohort. Do not assume a common representation or allow absent values to stand for a shared place.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separately authorized implementation and validation, examine distinct/same settlements, absent locations, distinct/same supported case sites or journeys, direct authorized calls and gateway flows, NPC scheduling and observer baseline creation while preserving legitimate frozen daily receipts. None ran.
candidates.discovery: partial; admissible geographic modes, direct access and all callers, exact temporal location policy and aliases remain open
